notes.title: myPhone
notes.content:
myPhone

I forget stuff.

This phone doesn't.

Everything in here matters.

Some of it more than I like.

If you're trying to figure me out...

You're probably looking in the right place.

Just not all in the same place.

────────────────────────

Messages

Some conversations ended.

Some just... stopped.

────────────────────────

Music

Listen in order.

Don't cheat.

────────────────────────

Mail

Bills.

Business.

A couple surprises.

────────────────────────

Photos

Wish I deleted a few of these.

Glad I didn't.

────────────────────────

Notes

Half reminders.

Half overthinking.

────────────────────────

Phone

I answer when I answer.

────────────────────────

Maps

Funny how places can feel different after enough time passes.

────────────────────────

Supply

Been building this one for a minute.

────────────────────────

Settings

Change what you want.

Some things don't need changing.

────────────────────────

Anyway...

Back to whatever you were doing.

notes.title: IDEAS
notes.content:
IDEAS

Ideas

POV only.

No face reveal.

People should feel like they're holding somebody else's phone.

Not using a website.

----------

Delete more.

Say less.

----------

Call it "Recently Deleted?"

----------

Don't explain everything.

If they get it...
they get it.

----------

Need a better ending.

----------

Everything should connect somehow.

Even if nobody notices.

----------

Stop chasing perfect.

Finish it.

----------

Real timestamps.

Real places.

Real feeling.

----------

One night.

One phone.

One story.

----------

Remember...

The little details are the big details.

notes.title: TO DO
notes.content:
TO DO

To Do

Finish what I started.

Call Mom.

Return three missed calls.

Get gas.

Stop overthinking everything.

Delete those screenshots.

Figure out dinner before 9 this time.

Buy another notebook.

Remember where I parked.

Charge everything.

Finish what I keep putting off.

Sleep.

Actually sleep.

notes.title: RULES
notes.content:
RULES

Rules

Don't force anything.

Protect your peace.

Answer actions.

Not words.

If it costs your peace...

It's too expensive.

Never chase.

Leave when it's time.

Keep your circle small.

Move in silence.

Finish what you start.

Say less.

Watch more.

Some doors close for a reason.

Some people do too.

Keep going.

notes.title: Recently Deleted
notes.content:
Recently Deleted

The story only works if you listen in order.

Each song is a different moment.

Some happen minutes apart.

Some only make sense after you've heard the next one.

-------------------------

Face ID

The night starts here.

Trying to hold onto someone who's already slipping away.

-------------------------

Delivered

Sometimes seeing "Delivered" hurts more than being left on read.

-------------------------

DND

The world keeps calling.

Some nights you don't answer.

-------------------------

White Bronco

Running from everything.

Even the things you can't outrun.

-------------------------

Favorites

The people closest to you usually know exactly how to hurt you.

-------------------------

Dark Mode

Not sadness.

Just... disconnecting.

-------------------------

Missed Call

Sometimes silence says everything.

-------------------------

Naomi

You can leave.

Some people still find a way back.

-------------------------

Noelle

Good timing doesn't always mean good intentions.

-------------------------

Amber

The right person.

The wrong moment.

-------------------------

Selina

Sometimes nobody wins.

Sometimes people just stop trying.

-------------------------

Ed

No excuses.

No pretending.

Just me.
